Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study describes two separate proteomics workflows: one for IVD tissue using DDA and LFQ (MaxQuant), and one for plasma using SWATH-MS (DIA) and DIANN. Per the priority for Stage 4 base selection, the DDA-LFQ tissue workflow is the primary signal for the base_dda_lfq candidate. The plasma workflow used SWATH-MS, which is a form of DIA, but the primary metadata and detailed search parameters provided in the text focus heavily on the DDA-LFQ tissue analysis.

scope: To extract protein for mass spectrometry, 25 μl of solubilisation buffer (5% (w/v) SDS in 50mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB, pH 7.55) was added to deparaffinised, rehydrated IVD tissue sections (2 × 5 μm per tube)
Lysates were acidified with 12 μl of 12% (v/v) phosphoric acid.
Acidified lysates were then centrifuged at 12000xg for 5 min and the supernatant was collected into a clean tube prior to proteolytic digestions using suspension trapping (S-Trap).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study analyzed both IVD tissue and plasma. For the tissue samples, the protocol describes the creation of lysates from tissue sections followed by S-Trap digestion, which corresponds to a whole cell/tissue lysate scope. While plasma was also analyzed (and immunodepleted), the primary tissue proteomics used unfractionated lysates.
